svg.aria-label: Sliding window mechanism map: the core expand/shrink loop, and nine variant diagrams.
svg.text: Every variant below is the same loop wearing a different "what does the window remember" costume.
The diagrams show the one thing that changes per variant; the code lives in 01–09*.js.
right sweeps the array once, always moving forward. Whenever the window stops being valid, left
sweeps forward too — never backward — which is why this is O(n) instead of O(n²).
What changes is what the window remembers
